## Problem and change

Describe the problem, implementation, and compatibility impact.

## Verification

List exact commands, results, and any checks not run.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests and documentation cover the change.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, or real recovery files are included.
- [ ] Security and authorization implications are explained.
- [ ] Third-party licenses and notices are preserved.
- [ ] UI changes include responsive and keyboard-accessibility checks.
